description: Stable error codes shared by ohos-app / ohos-hap / ohos-device. Machine consumers MUST use code, never human text.

codes.ERR_INVALID_REQUEST: request failed contract validation (missing/unknown field, wrong type, version mismatch)
codes.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE: a required feature is not supported by the selected backend/engine
codes.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL: protocol/schema major version not supported; fail closed, never fall back to a legacy command
codes.ERR_PATH_ESCAPE: a relative path escaped the canonical keg root or traversed a symlink
codes.ERR_SECRET_IN_CLEAR: a secret value (not a ref) appeared in a request, argv, log or descriptor
codes.ERR_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: requested install backend is not available; explicit hdc/sideload fails without fallback
codes.ERR_INSTALL_REJECTED: user rejected the system installer confirmation
codes.ERR_INSTALL_CANCELLED: user or system cancelled the install
codes.ERR_INSTALL_FAILED: system install failed; official error code preserved in detail
codes.ERR_WAIT_TIMEOUT: local wait for the interactive install ended; NOT an install failure — operation_id + last state retained
codes.ERR_WAIT_INTERRUPTED: local wait was interrupted; operation_id retained, no auto-retry
codes.ERR_STATUS_QUERY_UNSUPPORTED: backend cannot query operation status; no pending DB may be fabricated
codes.ERR_OPERATION_UNKNOWN: operation id not found / handle expired; query bundle state before deciding
codes.ERR_POST_INSTALL_VERIFY_FAILED: bm dump post-check did not match requested bundle/version/cert/permissions
codes.ERR_SIGN_FAILED: signing backend failed; output not published
codes.ERR_SIGN_VERIFY_FAILED: post-sign structural/signature verification failed; output not published
codes.ERR_DECODER_LAYOUT_UNKNOWN: DevEco decoder layout unrecognised; fail closed before any network/profile operation
codes.ERR_VENDOR_AUTH_REQUIRED: vendor debug signing needs an explicit login/refresh; no implicit browser popup
